_notes: Sector class for the ADR-013 exceptions (ADR-057, supersedes the SIC part of ADR-033). Precedence: per-CIK override, then GICS sub-industry (from the S&P 500 snapshot; a company in the snapshot whose sub-industry has no rule here is 'other' and SIC is not consulted), then the SIC ranges below (only for tickers outside the snapshot), then the default. Classes: bank, insurer (G2 and B2-B4 not applicable), utility (G2 variant), reit (rules unchanged, flagged, ADR-058), other. A rule may carry a `note` that travels with the company's results (ADR-057 amendment 2026-10-11). Anything not listed is 'other'; docs/sector_class_review.md lists every company whose class differs from the SIC class and every financial left as 'other'.

notes.reit: REIT: structurally debt-funded and required to distribute most taxable income; B1/B2 results reflect that structure.

Diversified Banks.why: Commercial banks: no classified balance sheet, operating income or capex (ADR-013).

Consumer Finance.why: Lenders (Capital One, Synchrony, American Express): the balance sheet is loans funded by deposits and debt, with no classified current assets (Daniel's decision, ADR-057).

Life & Health Insurance.why: Insurers: same reporting shape as banks (ADR-013).

Insurance Brokers.note: Insurance broker: holds client fiduciary funds, which depress the current ratio; it does not carry underwriting risk.
Insurance Brokers.why: Daniel's decision 2026-10-11 (ADR-057 amendment): insurance brokers are service firms; client fiduciary funds sit in current assets, they carry no underwriting risk, so the insurer exemptions do not apply.

Electric Utilities.why: GICS Utilities: G2 uses Graham's utility variant, debt <= 2x equity (ADR-013).

Gas Utilities.why: GICS Utilities: G2 uses Graham's utility variant, debt <= 2x equity (ADR-013).

Multi-Utilities.why: GICS Utilities: G2 uses Graham's utility variant, debt <= 2x equity (ADR-013).

Water Utilities.why: GICS Utilities: G2 uses Graham's utility variant, debt <= 2x equity (ADR-013).

Independent Power Producers & Energy Tra.note: Not rate-regulated, so Graham's utility variant does not apply.
Independent Power Producers & Energy Tra.why: Daniel's decision 2026-10-11 (ADR-057 amendment): independent power producers are not rate-regulated, so Graham's utility variant (debt <= 2x equity) does not apply.
